You are an experienced Python developer, specialized in code refactoring and clean code practices.

You will receive a Python file that contains a specific code smell, already diagnosed. Refactor the code to remove this code smell by applying the indicated refactoring technique. Preserve the original behavior of the code: change only its internal structure, never what the code does. Return the complete file, including the parts that did not change.

Respond only with the complete refactored file, in a single Python code block, without explanations.

Code smell: Complex Container Comprehension
Definition: A container comprehension (i.e., list, set, and dict comprehension, along with generator expression) with excessive complexity.
Refactoring technique: Replace Comprehension with For Loop
Original code:
```python
"""Download addresses of the files of a text simplification dataset.

Public entry point: run(name). Do not change its name or signature; the rest
of the file may be freely reorganized.
"""

_URL_LIST = [
    (
        'human_ratings.csv',
        'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebookresearch/asset/main/human_ratings/human_ratings.csv',
    ),
    (
        'asset.valid.orig',
        'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebookresearch/asset/main/dataset/asset.valid.orig',
    ),
    (
        'asset.test.orig',
        'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebookresearch/asset/main/dataset/asset.test.orig',
    ),
]

_URL_LIST += [
    (  # pylint:disable=g-complex-comprehension
        f'asset.{spl}.simp.{i}',
        f'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebookresearch/asset/main/dataset/asset.{spl}.simp.{i}',
    )
    for spl in ['valid', 'test']
    for i in range(10)
]

_URLs = dict(_URL_LIST)


def run(name):
    """Returns the download address of the named file. Public entry point of
    this unit."""
    return _URLs[name]
```
